n: Model AI Assignments: Act Out an LLM
t: A 15 minute class activity where students vote token by token to act as an LLM.
steps: Find Act Out an LLM on the Model AI Assignments site.
Download the classroom slides and the facilitator guide.
Prepare the token options for voting.
Choose a prompt. The example prompt is Tell me a fun fact about potatoes.
Run the core activity in about 15 minutes.
Choose an extension, such as comparing with a real LLM.
